$comment: Links and facts the page shows. A null link is left out of the page. url: the public address of the site, ending in /; while it is null (unknown) the build writes no canonical, hreflang, og:url or sitemap.xml, and robots.txt has no Sitemap line.

downloads.$comment: The download buttons link to https://github.com/<github.owner>/<github.repo from release.config.json>/releases/latest/download/<name>: fixed-name copies every release uploads, so the links never change. null: no button (Linux shows a disabled 'coming soon' entry instead).
